findings.frozenDecision: 华电国际 High-priority selection via company_engine_override over 华能国际/国电电力
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: The earnings bridge itself persisted rather than failing. 华电国际 Q3 attributable profit later rose 181.43% YoY and YTD profit 92.49%, while the stock still underperformed both frozen peers at the pre-registered 60d horizon.
findings.rootCause: V1.0 treated all opposite-sign 20d/60d excess-return states as one 'mixed' dislocation. 华电 entered with 20d excess -5.98pp but 60d excess +26.55pp: a late reversal after substantial prior rerating. This is economically different from an early turn where 20d becomes positive while 60d remains negative.
findings.generalLesson: A company-engine override should distinguish de-rated/early-turn price states from late-reversal states. Strong realized fundamentals are not sufficient if the longer-horizon rerating has already occurred and the shorter horizon is reversing.

findings.frozenDecision: 春秋航空 Research selection; no High-priority override because sector timing was adverse and peer-relative valuation/asymmetry was mixed
findings.label: research_only_correct
findings.generalLesson: A realized company recovery does not justify an override when valuation slack and clear peer asymmetry are absent.

findings.frozenDecision: 天齐锂业 Research selection because the new lithium rebound was proxy-only and the sector regime was adverse
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: 天齐 H1 attributable profit fell 37.52% YoY and Q2 profit was much lower sequentially as lithium chemical selling prices fell, confirming that strong Q1 legacy earnings did not prove the new May-June spot rebound had converted.
findings.label: proxy_conversion_correctly_demoted
findings.generalLesson: Strong trailing earnings cannot substitute for a fresh earnings bridge tied to the newly discovered economic change.

crossWindowDislocationCheck.interpretation: The current 'mixed' label is directionally ambiguous. Early-turn and late-reversal states carry opposite expectation-absorption meaning.

prohibitedUses: Do not alter the frozen v1.0 2023Q2 run.
Do not claim a revised dislocation rule works from this same-period failure.
Do not add industry, valuation, or return-magnitude thresholds from named cases.

nextValidation.proposedChangeOnly: Split mixed company price dislocation into early_turn and late_reversal; High-priority override may use de_rated or early_turn, not late_reversal.
nextValidation.requirement: Freeze v1.1 before any 2023Q3 outcome reveal; use a broad economic mix rather than targeting known override sectors.
